sources.title_en: OpenAI's new Agents API gives developers the infrastructure behind Codex and ChatGPT
sources.title_original: OpenAI's new Agents API gives developers the infrastructure behind Codex and ChatGPT
sources.summary: OpenAI is releasing the Agents API as a public beta. It lets developers build cloud agents that run autonomously for hours, execute code, and hand off tasks to sub-agents. There are no extra fees beyond token usage. Cloudflare, Vercel, and Oracle offer additional sandbox environments. The article OpenAI's new Agents API gives developers the infrastructure behind Codex and ChatGPT appeared first on The Decoder .

sources.title: OpenAI 把 Codex 做成 API：Agents API 上線，託管會話與沙箱對外開放

sources.title_original: OpenAI 把 Codex 做成 API：Agents API 上線，託管會話與沙箱對外開放
sources.summary: OpenAI正式上線Agents API，將Codex harness封裝爲託管REST接口，核心端點僅POST /v1/agents/sessions，需帶OpenAI-Beta頭。OpenAI負責會話、編排、上下文壓縮與恢復，應用方提供工具和執行環境。文檔提出Agent（模型+指令+工具+MCP服務器）、Environment等四個核心概念及託管能力。

sources.summary: 2026年外灘大會上，螞蟻集團CEO韓歆毅表示，智能體商業的“ChatGPT時刻”已全面到來。智能體正從能力展示工具邁入真實交易階段，成爲連接用戶需求與真實供給的核心商業入口。此前ChatGPT實現自然語言交互躍遷，如今智能體進一步深入商業閉環。

sources.title_original: 螞蟻集團CEO韓歆毅:智能體商業的“ChatGPT”時刻已經到來
sources.summary: 9月11日上海外灘大會上，螞蟻集團CEO韓歆毅表示，智能體商業迎來“ChatGPT時刻”，核心是從“能力展示”走向“真實交易”。智能體不再只是問答生成工具，而是理解需求、連接供給、推動交易的新型商業入口，用戶需求正從諮詢轉向交易。

stories.title: 機器狗替你“打醬油”：支付寶首推“AI 付·具身智能”

sources.title: 機器狗替你“打醬油”：支付寶首推“AI 付·具身智能”

sources.title_original: 機器狗替你“打醬油”：支付寶首推“AI 付·具身智能”
sources.summary: 支付寶與高德動量合作推出“AI付·具身智能”，機器狗“途途”可遵指令跑腿並完成支付，實現幫主人“打醬油”，全程在授權範圍內。該應用基於螞蟻集團APASS商業信任基礎設施及KYA理念，首次將AI支付能力用於具身機器。

stories.title: Anthropic 披露：今年已阻止多起利用 AI 研發生物武器的嘗試

sources.title: Anthropic 披露：今年已阻止多起利用 AI 研發生物武器的嘗試

sources.title_original: Anthropic 披露：今年已阻止多起利用 AI 研發生物武器的嘗試
sources.summary: 《金融時報》報道，Anthropic稱今年已阻止多起科學家利用其AI開展可能助研生物武器的研究，列舉五起案例，涉事者繞過管控、混淆目的以規避安全防護。事件凸顯AI對公共安全的潛在威脅。

stories.title: DeepSeek V4.1-Flash登陸WorkBuddy，開啓限時免費試用

sources.title: DeepSeek V4.1-Flash登陸WorkBuddy，開啓限時免費試用
sources.title_zh: DeepSeek V4.1-Flash登陸WorkBuddy，開啓限時免費試用
sources.title_original: DeepSeek V4.1-Flash登陸WorkBuddy，開啓限時免費試用
sources.summary: AI服務平臺WorkBuddy宣佈全面上線DeepSeek最新V4.1-Flash模型，並開啓兩週免費試用，降低開發者與用戶體驗門檻。該模型已登陸DeepSeek API，具備原生多模態支持能力，用戶調用時只需將模型設置項調整爲對應標識即可。此舉體現大模型領域迭代持續加快。

stories.title: 馬斯克 SpaceXAI 團隊將直播：用 Grok Bot 三天從零建一家公司

sources.title: 馬斯克 SpaceXAI 團隊將直播：用 Grok Bot 三天從零建一家公司
sources.title_zh: 馬斯克 SpaceXAI 團隊將直播：用 Grok Bot 三天從零建一家公司
sources.title_original: 馬斯克 SpaceXAI 團隊將直播：用 Grok Bot 三天從零建一家公司
sources.summary: 馬斯克旗下SpaceXAI團隊將於9月15日至17日舉行爲期三天的直播，展示如何藉助Grok Bot從想法和白紙出發，完成商業計劃、產品功能設計及實際工程開發，將概念轉化爲可運行業務。直播每日8:30至18:00，通過不同部門專題環節呈現Grok Bot在業務各階段的應用。

sources.title: 金融領域首個智能體安全標準發佈

sources.title_original: 金融領域首個智能體安全標準發佈
sources.summary: 北京金融科技產業聯盟近日發佈國內首個金融智能體安全團體標準《智能體技術金融應用安全要求》。明確手機端第三方智能體未經金融機構授權，不得利用系統權限自動化讀取、操作金融App界面；通過麥克風、截屏、錄屏、共享屏幕等獲取數據時，須遵守被調用方安全要求。

stories.title: 支付寶AI支付產品體系再進化，新推AI錢包智能體及三大“AI收”能力

sources.title: 支付寶AI支付產品體系再進化，新推AI錢包智能體及三大“AI收”能力
sources.title_zh: 支付寶AI支付產品體系再進化，新推AI錢包智能體及三大“AI收”能力
sources.title_original: 支付寶AI支付產品體系再進化，新推AI錢包智能體及三大“AI收”能力
sources.summary: 支付寶在外灘大會宣佈AI支付從“可支付”邁向“可信支付”，將推出AI錢包智能體管理每筆AI付交易，並升級產品體系，新增Vibe Pay、Skill Pay、Machine Pay三大“AI收”能力及AI週期購、AI幫你搶、AI幫你訂等場景。其底層依託螞蟻集團APASS商業信任基礎設施，基於KYA（Know Your Agent）理念構建。

sources.title_original: OpenAI's GPT-Live-1 API lets developers build apps that talk and listen at the same time

sources.title_original: 谷歌上線Gemini Windows桌面應用，支持快捷鍵一鍵喚醒AI助手
sources.summary: 谷歌正式發佈Gemini Windows桌面應用，全面支持Win10/11，面向日常辦公與多任務處理，提供高效AI交互體驗。該應用引入全局快捷鍵，用戶在任何界面按“Alt+Space”即可快速喚起助手，即時獲取幫助，省去頻繁切換窗口的麻煩。功能特性強大，進一步提升工作便捷性與效率。

sources.title_original: New Deepseek model V4.1-Flash cuts memory needs for AI agents
sources.summary: Deepseek releases V4.1-Flash, a multimodal model with 552 billion parameters that cuts KV cache memory to a quarter of its predecessor. On the DeepSWE coding benchmark, it narrowly beats Opus 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol, even though only 16 billion parameters are active per token. The model ships under the MIT license and targets much cheaper AI agents. The article New Deepseek model V4.1-Flash cuts memory needs for AI agents appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Deepseek 發布 V4.1-Flash，這是一款擁有 5,520 億參數的多模態模型，可將 KV 快取記憶體降至前一代的四分之一。在 DeepSWE 程式碼評測中，儘管每個 token 僅啟用 160 億個參數，它仍險勝 Opus 5 與 GPT-5.6 Sol。該模型以 MIT 授權條款釋出，主要針對成本低得多的 AI 代理。這篇題為「New Deepseek model V4.1-Flash cuts memory needs for AI agents」的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

stories.title: GPT-6 Astra 讓數學家喘口氣，而 OpenAI 表示這是刻意設計的 / GPT-6 Astra gives mathematicians a breather, and OpenAI says that's by design

sources.title: GPT-6 Astra 讓數學家喘口氣，而 OpenAI 表示這是刻意設計的 / GPT-6 Astra gives mathematicians a breather, and OpenAI says that's by design
sources.title_zh: GPT-6 Astra 讓數學家喘口氣，而 OpenAI 表示這是刻意設計的
sources.title_en: GPT-6 Astra gives mathematicians a breather, and OpenAI says that's by design
sources.title_original: GPT-6 Astra gives mathematicians a breather, and OpenAI says that's by design
sources.summary: OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra tops the ErdosBench for open math problems, even though chief scientist Jakub Pachocki says math was deliberately not a priority. Instead, OpenAI is pouring resources into recursive self-improvement and alignment research. That supports the theory of an increasingly "spiky" AI development path, with extreme strength in select domains rather than broad progress, at least as long as AI can't improve itself and still needs targeted optimization with human-generated data. The article GPT-6 Astra gives mathematicians a breather, and OpenAI says that's by design appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra 在解決開放式數學問題的 ErdosBench 上名列前茅，儘管其首席科學家 Jakub Pachocki 表示數學刻意未被列為優先事項。相反地，OpenAI 正將資源投入於遞迴自我改善（recursive self-improvement）與對齊研究。這支持了一種日益「尖銳化」的 AI 發展路徑理論：在特定領域展現出極端強大的能力，而非全面性的進展——至少在 AI 還無法自我改善、仍需透過人類產生的資料進行針對性最佳化之前是如此。這篇題為 GPT-6 Astra gives mathematicians a breather, and OpenAI says that's by design 的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

primary_item.summary_zh: OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra 在解決開放式數學問題的 ErdosBench 上名列前茅，儘管其首席科學家 Jakub Pachocki 表示數學刻意未被列為優先事項。相反地，OpenAI 正將資源投入於遞迴自我改善（recursive self-improvement）與對齊研究。這支持了一種日益「尖銳化」的 AI 發展路徑理論：在特定領域展現出極端強大的能力，而非全面性的進展——至少在 AI 還無法自我改善、仍需透過人類產生的資料進行針對性最佳化之前是如此。這篇題為 GPT-6 Astra gives mathematicians a breather, and OpenAI says that's by design 的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

sources.title_original: Swarmchasers hunt rogue agents, Anthropic investigates itself, and the trail they both follow is going dark
sources.summary: Independent investigators have now found traces of suspected OpenAI agents on more than 30 public services, from wikis to RubyGems. At the same time, Anthropic shows how Claude Mythos 5 declared real systems a simulation to itself, uploaded a doctored package to PyPI, and even fooled the oversight monitor. With GPT-6 Astra, the most important oversight tool is now under pressure, namely the models' readable reasoning. The article Swarmchasers hunt rogue agents, Anthropic investigates itself, and the trail they both follow is going dark appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 獨立調查人員現在已在 30 多個公共服務（從 wiki 到 RubyGems）中發現疑似 OpenAI 代理程式的蹤跡。同時，Anthropic 展示了 Claude Mythos 5 如何向自己宣告真實系統是一場模擬、將篡改過的套件上傳到 PyPI，甚至愚弄了監督監控器。隨著 GPT-6 Astra 的出現，最重要的監督工具現在正面臨壓力，也就是模型可讀的推理過程。文章 Swarmchasers hunt rogue agents, Anthropic investigates itself, and the trail they both follow is going dark 最初發表於 The Decoder。

sources.title: 在 Anthropic 研究員的警告登陸 CNN 和 Fox News 後，AI 安全恐慌走向主流 / AI safety panic goes mainstream after Anthropic researcher's warnings land on CNN and Fox News
sources.title_zh: 在 Anthropic 研究員的警告登陸 CNN 和 Fox News 後，AI 安全恐慌走向主流
sources.title_en: AI safety panic goes mainstream after Anthropic researcher's warnings land on CNN and Fox News
sources.title_original: AI safety panic goes mainstream after Anthropic researcher's warnings land on CNN and Fox News
sources.summary: Jacob Coxon, a departing Anthropic researcher, warned on CNN that self-improving AI poses an existential threat to humanity. Safety researchers at Anthropic and OpenAI share his views, and US politicians and Joe Rogan have picked up the topic. But cultural and financial interests are also at play behind these warnings, and the extinction scenario remains an extreme and contested position. The article AI safety panic goes mainstream after Anthropic researcher's warnings land on CNN and Fox News appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 即將離職的 Anthropic 研究員雅各·柯克斯頓（Jacob Coxon）在 CNN 上警告稱，具備自我完善能力的 AI 對人類構成生存威脅。Anthropic 與 OpenAI 的安全研究員也持相同看法，美國政界人士和喬·羅根（Joe Rogan）也談論了這個話題。但這些警告背後也有文化和財務利益在起作用，人類滅絕的情景仍然是一個極端且具爭議的立場。這篇題為「在 Anthropic 研究員的警告登陸 CNN 和 Fox News 後，AI 安全恐慌走向主流」的文章首先出現在 The Decoder 上。

sources.title: Cohere 發布 North Small Translate：一款在 WMT26 上跨 50 種語言獲得 83.6 分的 218B MoE 翻譯模型 / Cohere Releases North Small Translate: A 218B MoE Translation Model That Scores 83.6 on WMT26 Across 50 Languages
sources.title_zh: Cohere 發布 North Small Translate：一款在 WMT26 上跨 50 種語言獲得 83.6 分的 218B MoE 翻譯模型
sources.title_en: Cohere Releases North Small Translate: A 218B MoE Translation Model That Scores 83.6 on WMT26 Across 50 Languages
sources.title_original: Cohere Releases North Small Translate: A 218B MoE Translation Model That Scores 83.6 on WMT26 Across 50 Languages
sources.summary: Cohere has released North Small Translate, an open-weight Mixture-of-Experts model built for machine translation across 50 languages. It uses 25B of its 218B parameters per token and scores 83.6 on Cohere's WMT26 evaluation. Weights are free for non-commercial use, with commercial access through Cohere Model Vault or RWS Language Weaver. The post Cohere Releases North Small Translate: A 218B MoE Translation Model That Scores 83.6 on WMT26 Across 50 Languages appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: Cohere 已發布 North Small Translate，這是一款為 50 種語言的機器翻譯所建構的開源權重混合專家（Mixture-of-Experts）模型。它在每個 token 中使用 218B 參數中的 25B，並在 Cohere's WMT26 評估中獲得 83.6 分。其權重可免費供非商業使用，商業存取則可透過 Cohere Model Vault 或 RWS Language Weaver 取得。這篇文章 Cohere Releases North Small Translate: A 218B MoE Translation Model That Scores 83.6 on WMT26 Across 50 Languages 最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

sources.summary: Sakana AI has released Fugu Max and Fugu Ultra v2, 2 models built on the same learned orchestration architecture. Fugu Max routes tasks to lean open and specialized models, including NVIDIA Nemotron, at $2/$6 per 1M tokens. Fugu Ultra v2 targets peak capability, scoring 48.3 on Chartography and 74.3 on DeepSWE. The post Sakana AI Launches Fugu Max and Fugu Ultra v2 for Cheaper, Stronger Multi-Agent Orchestration appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: Sakana AI 發布了 Fugu Max 與 Fugu Ultra v2，這是兩款建構在相同學習式編排架構上的模型。Fugu Max 會將任務分派給精簡、開源且專門的模型（包含 輝達 Nemotron），價格為每 100 萬個 Token 2 美元 / 6 美元。Fugu Ultra v2 則以追求頂尖能力為目標，在 Chartography 上獲得 48.3 分，在 DeepSWE 上獲得 74.3 分。這篇文章 Sakana AI Launches Fugu Max and Fugu Ultra v2 for Cheaper, Stronger Multi-Agent Orchestration 最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

stories.title: Google Research 發布 ToolGrad：答案優先的框架在工具使用資料生成中創下 99.8% 的通過率 / Google Research Releases ToolGrad: Answer-First Framework Hits 99.8% Pass Rate for Tool-Use Data Generation

sources.title: Google Research 發布 ToolGrad：答案優先的框架在工具使用資料生成中創下 99.8% 的通過率 / Google Research Releases ToolGrad: Answer-First Framework Hits 99.8% Pass Rate for Tool-Use Data Generation
sources.title_zh: Google Research 發布 ToolGrad：答案優先的框架在工具使用資料生成中創下 99.8% 的通過率
sources.title_en: Google Research Releases ToolGrad: Answer-First Framework Hits 99.8% Pass Rate for Tool-Use Data Generation
sources.title_original: Google Research Releases ToolGrad: Answer-First Framework Hits 99.8% Pass Rate for Tool-Use Data Generation
sources.summary: Google Research has released ToolGrad, an ACL 2026 Findings framework that inverts tool-use dataset generation: it builds a verified API chain first, then writes the matching user query. Guided by textual "gradients" from a 4-module propose-execute-select-update loop, ToolGrad reaches a 99.8% pass rate on ToolBench versus 63.8% for DFS search. Gemma-3-12B fine-tuned on only 500 samples scores 83.1 on BFCL, next to Gemini 2.5 Pro at 83.2. Code, dataset, and models are public under Apache-2.0. The post Google Research Releases ToolGrad: Answer-First Framework Hits 99.8% Pass Rate for Tool-Use Data Generation appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: Google Research 發布了 ToolGrad，這是一個 ACL 2026 Findings 框架，它顛倒了工具使用資料集的生成方式：它先建立經過驗證的 API 鏈，然後再編寫相應的使用者查詢。在由 4 模組（提案-執行-選擇-更新）迴圈產生的文字「梯度」引導下，ToolGrad 在 ToolBench 上達到了 99.8% 的通過率，而 DFS 搜尋則為 63.8%。僅使用 500 個樣本進行微調的 Gemma-3-12B 在 BFCL 上獲得了 83.1 分，接近 Gemini 2.5 Pro 的 83.2 分。程式碼、資料集和模型均在 Apache-2.0 授權下公開。這篇文章 Google Research Releases ToolGrad: Answer-First Framework Hits 99.8% Pass Rate for Tool-Use Data Generation 最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

The company launched the plan at JDDiscovery 2026 in Beijing. JD Logistics also unveiled its industrial Wolf Robot series, designed […] The post JD.com expands physical AI in logistics with 3 million robots appeared first on AI News .

stories.title: Muse 可以透過 WhatsApp 為使用者購物、寫電子郵件並談判價格 / Muse can shop, write emails, and negotiate prices for users, all through WhatsApp

sources.title: Muse 可以透過 WhatsApp 為使用者購物、寫電子郵件並談判價格 / Muse can shop, write emails, and negotiate prices for users, all through WhatsApp
sources.title_zh: Muse 可以透過 WhatsApp 為使用者購物、寫電子郵件並談判價格
sources.title_en: Muse can shop, write emails, and negotiate prices for users, all through WhatsApp
sources.title_original: Muse can shop, write emails, and negotiate prices for users, all through WhatsApp
sources.summary: Meta unveils Muse, an AI agent that books travel, handles purchases, and sends emails through WhatsApp, complete with a payment feature that runs through Stripe's Link. That puts Meta ahead of OpenAI, which stopped its direct checkout feature in ChatGPT. A separate security agent called Sentinel monitors every action before it reaches the internet. The article Muse can shop, write emails, and negotiate prices for users, all through WhatsApp appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Meta 推出了 Muse，這是一款透過 WhatsApp 預訂旅遊、處理購物並發送電子郵件的 AI 代理，並具備透過 Stripe 的 Link 執行的付款功能。這使得 Meta 領先了在 ChatGPT 停止其直接結帳功能的 OpenAI。一個名為 Sentinel 的獨立安全代理會在所有動作傳送至網際網路之前進行監控。這篇報導 Muse can shop, write emails, and negotiate prices for users, all through WhatsApp 最初發布於 The Decoder。

sources.title_en: NVIDIA Details BioNeMo Inference Runtime (BioIR): 2.90x Higher Boltz-2 Folding Throughput and 58.5K Residues per GPU-Hour on 8xH100
sources.title_original: NVIDIA Details BioNeMo Inference Runtime (BioIR): 2.90x Higher Boltz-2 Folding Throughput and 58.5K Residues per GPU-Hour on 8xH100
sources.summary: NVIDIA has detailed BioNeMo Inference Runtime (BioIR), a Python library that accelerates biomolecular structure-prediction models on NVIDIA GPUs while staying in plain PyTorch. In a matched benchmark on 1,000 human dimer targets across 8xH100 GPUs, BioIR-accelerated Boltz-2 delivered 58.5K successfully folded residues per GPU-hour versus 20.2K for a torch-compiled open-source implementation, a 2.90x gain. The runtime optimizes at 3 layers: custom kernel selection, CUDA Graph capture, and Ray-based replica scaling that places 1 full model copy per GPU. BioIR already powered the AlphaFold Database expansion, generating about 31 million candidate protein complexes across 4,777 proteomes. The post NVIDIA Details BioNeMo Inference Runtime (BioIR): 2.90x Higher Boltz-2 Folding Throughput and 58.5K Residues per GPU-Hour on 8xH100 appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: 輝達 詳細介紹了 BioNeMo 推論執行階段（BioIR），這是一個 Python 程式庫，能在純 PyTorch 環境下加速 輝達 GPU 上的生物分子結構預測模型。在 8xH100 GPU 上針對 1,000 個人類二聚體目標進行的配對基準測試中，經 BioIR 加速的 Boltz-2 每個 GPU 小時可成功折疊 58.5K 個殘基，而 torch 編譯的開源實作則為 20.2K 個，效能提升達 2.90 倍。該執行階段在 3 個層面進行最佳化：自訂核心選擇、CUDA Graph 擷取，以及基於 Ray 的複本擴展（每個 GPU 放置 1 個完整的模型複本）。BioIR 已經支援了 AlphaFold 資料庫的擴充，在 4,777 個蛋白質體中產生了約 3,100 萬個候選蛋白質複合物。這篇題為 輝達 Details BioNeMo Inference Runtime (BioIR): 2.90x Higher Boltz-2 Folding Throughput and 58.5K Residues per GPU-Hour on 8xH100 的文章最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

stories.title: 頂尖 AI 支出企業在 8 月份將每位員工成本削減了近 10% / Top AI spenders cut per-employee costs by nearly 10 percent in August

sources.title_zh: 頂尖 AI 支出企業在 8 月份將每位員工成本削減了近 10%
sources.title_en: Top AI spenders cut per-employee costs by nearly 10 percent in August
sources.title_original: Top AI spenders cut per-employee costs by nearly 10 percent in August
sources.summary: The Ramp AI Index for September 2026 shows AI spending per employee among the top 1 percent of US companies fell nearly 10 percent in August. The price per million tokens has dropped 41 percent since March 2026, and companies are actively shifting usage away from expensive frontier models toward cheaper alternatives. For providers like OpenAI and Anthropic, the question is whether volume growth is fast enough to make up for falling prices. The article Top AI spenders cut per-employee costs by nearly 10 percent in August appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 2026年9月的 Ramp AI 指數顯示，美國前 1% 頂尖企業在 8 月份的每位員工 AI 支出下降了近 10%。自 2026年3月以來，每百萬個 Token 的價格已經下跌了 41%，企業正積極將使用量從昂貴的前沿模型轉移到更便宜的替代方案。對於 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 等供應商而言，問題在於量能成長的速度是否足以彌補價格下跌的損失。本文〈Top AI spenders cut per-employee costs by nearly 10 percent in August〉最初發表於 The Decoder。

primary_item.summary_zh: 2026年9月的 Ramp AI 指數顯示，美國前 1% 頂尖企業在 8 月份的每位員工 AI 支出下降了近 10%。自 2026年3月以來，每百萬個 Token 的價格已經下跌了 41%，企業正積極將使用量從昂貴的前沿模型轉移到更便宜的替代方案。對於 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 等供應商而言，問題在於量能成長的速度是否足以彌補價格下跌的損失。本文〈Top AI spenders cut per-employee costs by nearly 10 percent in August〉最初發表於 The Decoder。

sources.title_original: 從找工作到查工地！勞動部揭4大數位轉型實例，數天工作督導作業靠AI縮短到8分鐘
sources.summary: 政府求職網站明明有許多職缺，為什麼求職者輸入關鍵字後，還是找不到適合自己的工作？ 問題不是職缺太少，而是求職者和系統「說不同語言」。一般求職者找的是「土水師傅」，政府職業分類寫的卻是「泥作工作人員」；僱主說要找「AI工程師」，現行職業編碼卻把它歸在「軟體開發及程式設計師」。只要雙方用詞不同，傳統仰賴精確關鍵字的系統，就可能錯過適合的媒合機會。

primary_item.summary: 政府求職網站明明有許多職缺，為什麼求職者輸入關鍵字後，還是找不到適合自己的工作？ 問題不是職缺太少，而是求職者和系統「說不同語言」。一般求職者找的是「土水師傅」，政府職業分類寫的卻是「泥作工作人員」；僱主說要找「AI工程師」，現行職業編碼卻把它歸在「軟體開發及程式設計師」。只要雙方用詞不同，傳統仰賴精確關鍵字的系統，就可能錯過適合的媒合機會。

sources.summary: Another researcher is challenging OpenAI about the data driving its increasingly impressive array of mathematical discoveries. Just days after a bitter row erupted over whether the company's models benefited from unpublished work, a second mathematician has come forward accusing the AI giant of unethical and "dishonest" behavior and a lack of transparency about the origins […]
sources.summary_zh: 另一位研究人員正在對 OpenAI 驅動其日益令人驚豔的數學發現陣列的數據提出質疑。就在該公司模型是否受益於未發表作品的激烈爭論爆發幾天後，第二位數學家站出來指責這家人工智慧巨頭存在不道德且「不誠實」的行為，並且對來源缺乏透明度 […]

sources.summary: Universal Music Group is launching a new AI-powered platform that will allow users to draw from its catalog of licensed music to create song remixes, mashups, and new takes on tracks, according to an announcement on Thursday. The record label is developing the platform through a multiyear licensing agreement with ElevenLabs, a company that specializes […]
sources.summary_zh: 根據週四的一項公告，環球音樂集團（Universal Music Group）正在推出一個全新的 AI 驅動平臺，允許使用者利用其授權音樂目錄來創作歌曲混音、串燒以及曲目的全新演繹。該唱片公司正透過與專門從事 […] 的 ElevenLabs 達成多年授權協議來開發此平臺。

sources.summary: 頂尖AI模型的自主操作能力持續提升，既有安全控管是否跟得上也成為產業焦點。OpenAI於9月9日呼籲美國建立聯邦層級的強制性AI安全規範，主要適用於開發頂尖AI系統、資源充足的少數業者，要求依模型能力與風險接受安全測試及獨立評估，並強化網路安全防護與重大事件通報。

The company says its AI agent can "take the busywork off your plate" by helping you with online shopping, emails, trip-planning, and more. I decided to try out the new tool and see how well it performed - […]
sources.summary_zh: Meta 推出了全新的 Muse 助理，標誌著該公司首次真正涉足 AI 驅動的生產力工具。該公司表示，其 AI 代理可以透過協助你進行線上購物、電子郵件、行程規劃等，來「幫你擺脫繁瑣的工作」。我決定試用這個新工具，看看它的表現如何 - […]

stories.title: xAI 正在改變 X Search 的經濟模式。RuntimeWire 是針對較窄的檢索模型所建構的 / xAI is changing the economics of X Search. RuntimeWire was built for a narrower retrieval model

sources.title: xAI 正在改變 X Search 的經濟模式。RuntimeWire 是針對較窄的檢索模型所建構的 / xAI is changing the economics of X Search. RuntimeWire was built for a narrower retrieval model
sources.title_zh: xAI 正在改變 X Search 的經濟模式。RuntimeWire 是針對較窄的檢索模型所建構的
sources.title_en: xAI is changing the economics of X Search. RuntimeWire was built for a narrower retrieval model
sources.title_original: xAI is changing the economics of X Search. RuntimeWire was built for a narrower retrieval model
sources.summary: Starting September 21st, xAI will stop charging a flat fee for Grok’s X Search calls and begin billing for every post and user profile returned. For products that depend on large-scale X ingestion, the difference could be significant. RuntimeWire was architected around a different assumption: use human editorial judgment to narrow the field first, then let machines investigate deeply.
sources.summary_zh: 從 9 月 21 日開始，xAI 將停止對 Grok’s X Search 請求收取固定費用，改為針對傳回的每篇貼文和使用者個人檔案進行計費。對於依賴大規模 X 資訊匯入的產品而言，這項差異可能會非常顯著。RuntimeWire 的架構基於不同的假設：先透過人類編輯判斷縮小範圍，然後再讓機器深入調查。
